messages.author: f5bec70b36df06aa
messages.subject: change labels in facets
parts:
Hi

I have a problem with the labels ggplot uses for my facets. I would
like to change them to the proper chemical name, e.g. Nitrite, Nitrate
etc. However, I couldn't find any option to do that and I can't change
them in the original file because after the melt they will be changed
by ggplot anyway. Any ideas? Below is the code. Thanks, Martin

read.csv("/Volumes/MARTIN_DATA/PhD/PhD/data/Stats/2010_01_new_stats/R/
first_run/seasonal_var_sixmile.csv") -> seasonal
melt_seasonal <- melt(seasonal, id=c("ID", "date"), na.rm=TRUE)
ggplot(melt_seasonal, aes(x = date, y = value, group = ID)) +
geom_line(aes(color=factor(ID))) + geom_point(aes(shape = factor(ID)))
+ scale_shape(solid=FALSE) + facet_grid(variable ~ . , scales =
"free") + opts(legend.key=theme_rect(fill=NULL,colour="white")) +
scale_x_discrete(breaks=c("2008-10-26","2009-01-27","2009-03-16","2009-07-06","2009-07-20","2009-11-16"),
labels=c("26 Oct","27 Jan","16 Mar","6 Jul","20 Jul","16 Nov"))

messages.author: 40f7d34e9dd27d88
messages.subject: Re: change labels in facets
parts: hi,

On Wed, Feb 10, 2010 at 06:08:11PM -0800, waschbaer wrote:
> Hi
>
> I have a problem with the labels ggplot uses for my facets. I would
> like to change them to the proper chemical name, e.g. Nitrite, Nitrate
> etc. However, I couldn't find any option to do that and I can't change
> them in the original file because after the melt they will be changed
> by ggplot anyway. Any ideas? Below is the code. Thanks, Martin

how does ggplot change the labels?

I would change them in the original file, or, if that is easier, replace
the names of seasonal by the correct names before melting.

seasonal =
read.csv("http://dl.dropbox.com/u/4236038/seasonal_var_sixmile.csv")
names(seasonal)=c("ID","date","Nitrite","Nitrate","Ammonia","organic","phosphate","total")

ggplot(melt_seasonal, aes(x = date, y = value, group = ID)) +
geom_line(aes(color=factor(ID))) + geom_point(aes(shape=factor(ID))) +
scale_shape_discrete(solid=F) +

facet_grid(variable ~ . , scales ="free") +
opts(legend.key=theme_rect(fill=NULL,colour="white")) +
scale_x_discrete(breaks=c("2008-10-26","2009-01-27","2009-03-16",
"2009-07-06","2009-07-20","2009-11-16"),
labels=c("26 Oct","27 Jan","16 Mar","6 Jul","20 Jul","16 Nov"))

regards,
stefan

Try something like this,

baptiste
